### Creating a Welcoming Guest Room
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-10-20-04-1290839.html
Passage: 2 Kings 4:9-10
Points:
- The Shunammite woman demonstrated intentional hospitality by preparing a furnished resting space for Elisha.
- Homes can serve as practical ministry tools to convey God's love to visiting guests.
- Thoughtful hosts anticipate visitors' needs through small comforts, snacks, and welcoming amenities.
- Practicing Christian hospitality provides opportunities to care for others and draw them toward God.
